title: What If You Sold Every Minecraft Copy Yourself?
description:
What if you had to sell every Minecraft copy, one by one?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Minecraft: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minecraft
- Wikipedia: Mojang Studios: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mojang_Studios
- Wikipedia: Markus Persson: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markus_Persson

Wikipedia (Minecraft): the best-selling video game of all time, over 400 million copies sold; it passed one million purchases less than a month into its beta in early 2011, with no publisher and no ads beyond word of mouth. Wikipedia (Mojang Studios / Markus Persson): Microsoft agreed to buy Mojang for $2.5 billion in September 2014. Our math: 400 million seconds = about 12.7 years. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: What if you had to sell every Minecraft copy, one by one?
But it's over 400 million copies. The best-selling game ever.
One sale every second? That still takes 12.7 years.
It started tiny, though. Just word of mouth, no ads. Then a million sales.
Then Microsoft bought its maker for 2.5 billion dollars.
